required_changes: Introduce BrushPackage manifest/resource reader and deterministic normalization.
Introduce ResolvedBrushState and BrushExecutionPlan typed DAG with off/auto/on activation and dependency closure.
Introduce one common BrushSession lifecycle prepare/begin/append/seal/cancel with confirmed/predicted isolation.
Introduce BrushPreviewDelta and reliable BrushCommitIntent outputs with bounded preview handoff and CanonicalVisible receipt matching.
Integrate pinned Perfect Freehand R1 as VectorPathNode/perfect-freehand-r1 adapter and preserve its fixtures as oracle.
Move Web/Android/Windows ownership to the common session and remove new-path family/primitive interpretation.
Define the validated AddStroke intent adapter and fail closed before an unallocated persistence extension.
Add read-only legacy V1 decoder boundary and ensure new authoring cannot call legacy brush classes.
Add deterministic, replay, activation, prediction, handoff, platform ownership and regression evidence.
forbidden_changes: Create a second engine beside the new Brush Engine.
Use BrushFamily or product preset names to choose runtime pipeline semantics.
Interpret brush families, resources or geometry in platform bridges or renderers.
Persist an unapproved new protobuf field, allocate a new ObjectKind/OperationKind, or invent a version fallback.
Change C0/C1 input/routing, Arc selection, renderer architecture, or canvas-aware WetMix semantics.
Enter P32 or claim Gate PASS in this package.
